sudan.title: ضربة بمسيرة تقتل 80 مدنيا في السودان - Hespress
sudan.summary: ضربت طائرة مسيرة منطقة في السودان، مما أسفر عن مقتل 80 مدنياً. الحادث وقع في وقت تتصاعد فيه حدة النزاع بين القوات المسلحة السودانية وقوات الدعم السريع. يُعتقد أن الضربة كانت تستهدف مواقع عسكرية، لكنها أدت إلى سقوط عدد كبير من الضحايا المدنيين. وقد أثار هذا الهجوم إدانات واسعة من قبل منظمات حقوق الإنسان، التي دعت إلى ضرورة حماية المدنيين في النزاعات المسلحة. كما تم التأكيد على أهمية التحقيق في الحادث لضمان محاسبة المسؤولين. الوضع في السودان يظل متوتراً، مع استمرار القتال وتأثيره على السكان المدنيين.

sudan.title: «جريمة جديدة» لجيش السودان.. 80 قتيلًا في قصف على موقف مواصلات بكردفان - العين الإخبارية
sudan.summary: قُتل 80 شخصًا في قصف جوي استهدف موقف مواصلات في ولاية كردفان بالسودان، في حادثة جديدة تُضاف إلى سلسلة من الجرائم التي ارتكبها الجيش السوداني. الهجوم، الذي وقع في وقت متأخر من الليل، أسفر أيضًا عن إصابة العديد من المدنيين، مما أثار استنكارًا واسعًا من قبل منظمات حقوق الإنسان والمجتمع الدولي. يُعتبر هذا القصف جزءًا من تصعيد العنف في البلاد، حيث تتواصل الاشتباكات بين القوات المسلحة السودانية وقوات الدعم السريع. يُطالب الناجون وأسر الضحايا بتحقيق دولي في الحادثة، وسط مخاوف من تدهور الأوضاع الإنسانية في المنطقة.

sudan.title: 80 قتيلا في قصف بمسيرة في غرب كردفان بالسودان على موقف للشاحنات - القدس العربي
sudan.summary: قُتل 80 شخصًا في قصف بطائرة مسيرة استهدف موقفًا للشاحنات في غرب كردفان بالسودان. الهجوم وقع في منطقة تُعاني من صراعات مستمرة، حيث يُعتقد أن القصف كان يستهدف مجموعة من الأشخاص المتجمعين في الموقع. الحادث يُعكس تصاعد العنف في المنطقة، التي شهدت توترات متزايدة بين الجماعات المسلحة. السلطات المحلية لم تُصدر بعد بيانًا رسميًا حول الحادث، لكن التقارير تشير إلى أن الضحايا كانوا من المدنيين. يُعتبر هذا الهجوم من بين الأكثر دموية في الفترة الأخيرة، مما يثير القلق بشأن الأوضاع الإنسانية والأمنية في السودان.

sudan.title: تابع جنوب السودان ضد مصر - TOD
sudan.summary: جنوب السودان يواجه مصر في مباراة ودية لكرة القدم، حيث يسعى الفريقان لتحسين أدائهما قبل المنافسات الرسمية. المباراة تأتي في إطار استعدادات منتخب جنوب السودان، الذي يأمل في تعزيز مهارات لاعبيه وتطوير استراتيجيات اللعب. من جهة أخرى، يسعى منتخب مصر لاستغلال هذه الفرصة لتجربة تشكيلات جديدة وتقييم أداء اللاعبين قبل التصفيات المقبلة. اللقاء يعد فرصة جيدة لكلا الفريقين لاختبار قوتهما وتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف.

sudan.title: أربعة قتلى في هجمات بطائرات مسيّرة على الخرطوم - Dabanga Radio TV Online - Radio Dabanga
sudan.summary: أفادت تقارير بأن أربعة أشخاص لقوا حتفهم في هجمات بطائرات مسيّرة استهدفت العاصمة السودانية الخرطوم. الهجمات، التي وقعت في مناطق مختلفة من المدينة، أسفرت أيضًا عن إصابة عدد من المدنيين. تأتي هذه الأحداث في وقت يشهد فيه السودان تصاعدًا في التوترات والصراعات المسلحة، مما يزيد من معاناة السكان المدنيين. السلطات المحلية لم تقدم بعد تفاصيل دقيقة حول الجهة المسؤولة عن الهجمات أو الأهداف المحددة التي تم استهدافها. هذه الحوادث تبرز التحديات الأمنية المستمرة في البلاد وتفاقم الأوضاع الإنسانية.

sudan.title: السودان.. الجيش يحبط هجوما بريا بالنيل الأزرق ويتصدى لمسيّرات بالخرطوم - Anadolu Ajansı
sudan.summary: أحبط الجيش السوداني هجوماً برياً في ولاية النيل الأزرق، حيث تمكن من صد هجمات للمتمردين. كما تصدى الجيش لهجمات بطائرات مسيّرة في العاصمة الخرطوم، مما يعكس تصاعد التوترات في البلاد. تأتي هذه الأحداث في وقت يعاني فيه السودان من صراعات داخلية مستمرة، حيث يسعى الجيش للحفاظ على السيطرة في مواجهة التحديات الأمنية المتزايدة. وقد أشار الجيش إلى أنه سيواصل جهوده لحماية البلاد من أي تهديدات.

sudan.title: عشرات القتلى والجرحى جراء استهداف القوات المسلحة مدينتي الدبب والمجلد بغرب كردفان - Radio Dabanga
sudan.summary: استهدفت القوات المسلحة مدينتي الدبب والمجلد في غرب كردفان، مما أسفر عن مقتل وإصابة عشرات الأشخاص. الهجمات أدت إلى تدمير العديد من المنازل والبنية التحتية في المنطقة، مما زاد من معاناة السكان المحليين. وقد أعربت منظمات حقوق الإنسان عن قلقها إزاء تصاعد العنف وتأثيره على المدنيين. كما دعت إلى ضرورة حماية المدنيين وتقديم المساعدات الإنسانية للمتضررين. الوضع في غرب كردفان يظل متوتراً، مع استمرار الاشتباكات بين القوات المختلفة.

sudan.title: تصاعد غير مسبوق للدولار الجمركي وأسعار الصرف والذهب في السودان - سودان تربيون
sudan.summary: شهدت السودان تصاعداً غير مسبوق في أسعار الدولار الجمركي وأسعار الصرف والذهب، مما أدى إلى تفاقم الأوضاع الاقتصادية في البلاد. حيث ارتفع سعر الدولار الجمركي إلى مستويات قياسية، مما أثر سلباً على أسعار السلع الأساسية. كما سجلت أسعار الصرف في السوق السوداء ارتفاعاً ملحوظاً، مما زاد من معاناة المواطنين. في الوقت نفسه، شهدت أسعار الذهب أيضاً زيادة كبيرة، مما دفع العديد من المستثمرين إلى البحث عن ملاذات آمنة. تأتي هذه التطورات في ظل الأزمات الاقتصادية والسياسية التي تعاني منها البلاد، مما يثير القلق بشأن مستقبل الاقتصاد السوداني واستقرار الأسعار.

sudan.title: الجيش يعلن إحباط هجوم لـ«الدعم السريع والشعبية» بالنيل الأزرق - سودان تربيون
sudan.summary: أعلن الجيش السوداني عن إحباط هجوم لمجموعتي "الدعم السريع" و"الشعبية" في ولاية النيل الأزرق. وأكد المتحدث باسم الجيش أن القوات المسلحة تصدت للهجوم، مما أدى إلى وقوع اشتباكات عنيفة بين الطرفين. وأوضح أن الجيش تمكن من استعادة السيطرة على المناطق التي تعرضت للهجوم، مشيراً إلى أن الوضع تحت السيطرة. كما أشار إلى أن القوات المسلحة ستواصل عملياتها لحماية الأمن والاستقرار في المنطقة. يأتي هذا التطور في ظل تصاعد التوترات بين القوات المسلحة والمجموعات المسلحة في السودان.

sudan.title: اعتقال ثلاثة أشخاص في الروصيرص بالنيل الأزرق - Radio Dabanga
sudan.summary: اعتقلت السلطات في مدينة الروصيرص بولاية النيل الأزرق ثلاثة أشخاص بتهمة الانتماء إلى جماعات مسلحة. وأفادت مصادر محلية أن الاعتقالات جاءت بعد عمليات تفتيش نفذتها قوات الأمن في المنطقة، حيث تم ضبط أسلحة وذخائر بحوزة المعتقلين. وأشارت التقارير إلى أن هذه الخطوة تأتي في إطار جهود الحكومة لمكافحة التهديدات الأمنية وتعزيز الاستقرار في المنطقة. كما تم التأكيد على أن التحقيقات مستمرة مع المعتقلين لتحديد المزيد من التفاصيل حول أنشطتهم وعلاقاتهم المحتملة مع الجماعات المسلحة.

ethiopia.title: Ethiopia’s Naval Experience Contributes to Red Sea Security: Aregawi Berhe - ENA English
ethiopia.summary: Ethiopia's naval experience is playing a significant role in enhancing security in the Red Sea, according to Aregawi Berhe, the Director-General of the Ethiopian Maritime Affairs Authority. He emphasized that Ethiopia's strategic position and its commitment to maritime security are crucial for regional stability. The country has been actively involved in collaborative efforts with neighboring nations to address security challenges in the Red Sea, including piracy and illegal fishing. Aregawi highlighted the importance of building a capable navy and fostering partnerships to ensure safe navigation and protect maritime resources. Ethiopia's engagement in maritime security reflects its broader goals of contributing to peace and stability in the region.

ethiopia.title: Nile and Red Sea Inseparable Pillars Capable of Creating Regional Cooperation, Integration: Researchers - ENA English
ethiopia.summary: Researchers have emphasized the interconnectedness of the Nile and Red Sea as vital components for fostering regional cooperation and integration in East Africa. They argue that these two bodies of water are not only crucial for the ecological and economic stability of the region but also serve as platforms for collaborative initiatives among neighboring countries. By leveraging the resources and strategic significance of the Nile and Red Sea, nations can enhance trade, address environmental challenges, and promote sustainable development. The researchers advocate for a unified approach to managing these waterways, highlighting the potential benefits of regional partnerships in achieving long-term stability and prosperity.

ethiopia.title: Crisis in Central Ethiopia: 11 Dead as Armed Raids Devastate East Gurage - EthiopiaToday
ethiopia.summary: In East Gurage, Central Ethiopia, armed raids have resulted in the deaths of 11 individuals, exacerbating an ongoing crisis in the region. The violence has led to widespread fear and displacement among local communities. Authorities are struggling to maintain order as tensions rise, with reports of increased attacks and retaliatory violence. The situation has drawn attention from humanitarian organizations, which are concerned about the safety and well-being of affected populations. Efforts to restore peace and provide assistance are underway, but challenges remain significant as the conflict continues to escalate. The government has been urged to take decisive action to address the root causes of the violence and protect civilians.

ethiopia.title: Ethiopia warns Somaliland recognition could strengthen Al-Shabaab, Somaliland officials push back - Addis Standard
ethiopia.summary: Ethiopia has issued a warning that recognizing Somaliland as an independent state could bolster the influence of Al-Shabaab, the militant group operating in the region. Ethiopian officials argue that such recognition might destabilize the Horn of Africa and exacerbate security challenges. In response, Somaliland officials have pushed back against this assertion, emphasizing their desire for international recognition and asserting that their independence would not contribute to the strengthening of Al-Shabaab. They argue that Somaliland has maintained relative peace and stability compared to the rest of Somalia. The ongoing debate highlights the complex geopolitical dynamics in the region, as various stakeholders weigh the implications of Somaliland's quest for recognition against the backdrop of security concerns.

ethiopia.title: Alliance for Survival rejects Rubio’s characterization of #Ethiopia’s conflict as separatist, terrorist - Facebook
ethiopia.summary: The Alliance for Survival has rejected Senator Marco Rubio's characterization of the conflict in Ethiopia as separatist and terrorist in nature. The group argues that such labels misrepresent the complexities of the situation and undermine the legitimate grievances of various communities involved in the conflict. They emphasize that the ongoing violence is rooted in deeper political and social issues rather than a simple separatist agenda. The Alliance calls for a more nuanced understanding of the conflict and urges for dialogue and peaceful resolution rather than the use of inflammatory rhetoric. They stress the importance of addressing the underlying causes of the unrest to achieve lasting peace in the region.

ethiopia.title: Airbus Projects Sixfold Growth in Ethiopia's Air Passenger Traffic Over Next 20 Years
ethiopia.content: Ethiopia: Airbus Projects Sixfold Growth in Ethiopia's Air Passenger Traffic Over Next 20 Years - allAfrica.com AllAfrica English (current) En Français Toggle navigation My Account Toggle navigation AllAfrica My Account English (current) En Français Ethiopia: Airbus Projects Sixfold Growth in Ethiopia's Air Passenger Traffic Over Next 20 Years 19 October 2026 Ethiopian News Agency (Addis Ababa) Addis Ababa — Airbus has forecast a sixfold rise in Ethiopia's air passenger traffic over the next 20 years, saying Ethiopian Airlines is well placed to turn Addis Ababa into one of Africa's leading aviation hubs. It cited Ethiopian Airlines' expanding network, growing demand and planned airport infrastructure as key factors positioning Addis Ababa to become a leading aviation hub in Africa Airbus Vice President for Market Analysis and Forecast Antonio Da Costa told ENA that Ethiopia has strong growth potential, with Ethiopian Airlines well positioned to capitalize on rising passenger numbers and expanding regional and international connectivity. "We're obviously extremely proud to be a partner of Ethiopian Airlines," Da Costa said. "Ethiopian Airlines are our first A350 customer in Africa and have been a great customer of the 350 over the last 10 years." Follow us on WhatsApp | LinkedIn for the latest headlines Da Costa said the airline's established network, fleet capabilities and hub strategy would help it accommodate the projected increase in passenger traffic. "We obviously see a very good and strong potential of growth in Ethiopia with over six times more passengers coming over the next 20 years," he said. "So we believe that Ethiopian Airlines is well placed to cover and to take advantage of that growth." Airbus also projects that African air traffic will triple over the same period, creating opportunities for airlines and airports to expand capacity and strengthen connections across the continent and beyond. Da Costa said Addis Ababa's role in African aviation would become increasingly significant as Ethiopia develops its planned airport infrastructure, including the new airport project in Bishoftu. Ethiopia has described the Bishoftu airport project as the largest aviation infrastructure undertaking in Africa's history. Upon completion and full operation, the airport is expected to accommodate up to 110 million passengers annually and serve as Ethiopian Airlines' principal operating base. "We expect that Addis Ababa and with the new airport to become more and more a central hub for the traffic in Africa," Da Costa said. "We expect that growth of trans-African traffic for the Ethiopian coverage will be increasing by about six times over the next 20 years." Ethiopian Airlines became the first African operator of the Airbus A350 in 2016 and subsequently became the first African customer for the larger A350-1000, strengthening its position in the continent's long-haul aviation market. Da Costa described Ethiopian Airlines as a historic African carrier and reaffirmed Airbus's commitment to supporting its expansion with modern, fuel-efficient aircraft suited to its growing operational needs. "As we want to continue to grow with new aircraft, better aircraft, we're always open to hear from Ethiopian Airlines what their needs are," he said. "We will do our utmost to make sure that we can provide the best aircraft to serve the growing needs of the airline." He noted that connecting passengers account for nearly two-thirds of Ethiopian Airlines' traffic, highlighting Addis Ababa's importance as a transfer point linking destinations across Africa with Europe, Asia, the Americas and other international markets. "We're delighted that we have aircraft like the A350 that is capable of connecting Addis Ababa to effectively the whole world," Da Costa said. "By doing so, we believe that we're providing Ethiopian Airlines with the right tools to continue this strong growth." He added that Airbus would continue working with Ethiopian Airlines to provide aircraft, technical support and operational solutions to help the carrier expand efficiently and sustainably as demand for air travel increases. The projected growth would further strengthen Ethiopia's ambitions to consolidate its position as a major gateway for African aviation, while the planned airport infrastructure is expected to provide additional capacity to support the airline's long-term expansion. ethiopia.summary: Airbus has projected a sixfold increase in Ethiopia's air passenger traffic over the next 20 years, highlighting Ethiopian Airlines' potential to establish Addis Ababa as a major aviation hub in Africa. Key factors contributing to this growth include the airline's expanding network, rising demand, and planned airport infrastructure, particularly the new airport project in Bishoftu, which aims to accommodate up to 110 million passengers annually. Airbus Vice President Antonio Da Costa emphasized the airline's strong position to leverage this growth, noting that Ethiopian Airlines has been a significant customer for Airbus, including being the first African operator of the A350. The anticipated growth in Ethiopian air traffic aligns with Airbus's forecast of a tripling of air traffic across Africa, enhancing the continent's connectivity and capacity.

ethiopia.title: Ghana Set to Overtake Ethiopia As Africa's Eighth-Largest Economy After Kenya Takes East Africa Lead
ethiopia.content: East Africa: Ghana Set to Overtake Ethiopia As Africa's Eighth-Largest Economy After Kenya Takes East Africa Lead - allAfrica.com AllAfrica English (current) En Français Toggle navigation My Account Toggle navigation AllAfrica My Account English (current) En Français East Africa: Ghana Set to Overtake Ethiopia As Africa's Eighth-Largest Economy After Kenya Takes East Africa Lead 19 October 2026 Addis Standard (Addis Ababa) Addis Abeba — Ghana is projected to overtake Ethiopia as Africa's eighth-largest economy in 2026, with its gross domestic product (GDP) forecast to reach US$128.64 billion, exceeding Ethiopia's projected US$127.15 billion by US$1.49 billion, according to the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) October 2026 World Economic Outlook (WEO), as reported by African Business Insider on 17 October. The projected shift comes after Kenya overtook Ethiopia as East Africa's largest economy in nominal US dollar terms, marking another change in the continent's economic rankings driven partly by exchange-rate movements rather than differences in real economic growth. The IMF's latest estimates place Ghana eighth among Africa's largest economies, ahead of Ethiopia in ninth place and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), whose economy is projected at US$122.28 billion. While Ghana's nominal GDP is expected to edge ahead of Ethiopia's, the two countries have markedly different growth forecasts. Ethiopia's economy is projected to expand by 9.2% in real terms in 2026, compared with Ghana's forecast growth of 5.7%. However, the depreciation of the Ethiopian birr following the government's July 2024 foreign-exchange reforms has reduced the dollar value of the country's economic output, narrowing its position in nominal GDP rankings despite strong projected domestic growth. Follow us on WhatsApp | LinkedIn for the latest headlines Ghana's recovery and economic position Ghana's projected rise comes as the West African country continues to recover from a severe financial crisis marked by currency depreciation, high inflation, mounting public debt and pressure on government finances. In 2023, Ghana secured a US$3 billion IMF support programme aimed at restoring macroeconomic stability, addressing debt vulnerabilities and rebuilding investor confidence. The government subsequently pursued fiscal reforms, debt restructuring and measures to stabilise prices and the national currency. The country's economic position is also supported by exports of gold, cocoa, oil and gas, alongside financial services and a growing consumer market. Gold remains a major source of export earnings and foreign exchange, with higher international prices providing additional support to inflows. However, an improved position in nominal GDP rankings does not necessarily translate into higher living standards or stronger productive capacity. Sustaining the recovery will depend on Ghana's ability to attract long-term investment, create employment and expand industrial production. Ethiopia's growth versus dollar-denominated output Ethiopia's projected position reflects the distinction between real economic growth and nominal GDP measured in US dollars. While real GDP growth captures changes in domestic production after accounting for price changes, nominal GDP expressed in dollars is also affected by inflation and movements in the exchange rate. The depreciation of the birr following Ethiopia's July 2024 shift toward a more market-determined foreign-exchange system substantially reduced the dollar valuation of its output. The reform formed part of the government's broader economic programme, supported by an approximately US$3.4 billion IMF Extended Credit Facility. As Addis Standard reported last week, Kenya's emergence as East Africa's largest economy in dollar terms was similarly shaped by exchange-rate movements, with the comparatively stronger performance of the Kenyan shilling increasing the dollar value of its economic output. The IMF's October projections indicate that Ethiopia's economy is expected to grow by 9.2% in 2026 and 7.8% in 2027, while Kenya's growth is forecast at 4.5% and 4.7%, respectively. The figures highlight how an economy can record faster real growth without maintaining a higher ranking when GDP is measured in US dollars. The projected shift involving Ghana therefore does not, by itself, establish that its underlying economy is growing faster than Ethiopia's. Rather, it underscores the influence of exchange-rate movements and macroeconomic conditions on the relative dollar value of African economies. However, its October WEO, titled Resilience Under Strain, Urgent Choices, warns that high debt-servicing costs, limited foreign-exchange reserves and declining aid are constraining governments' ability to respond to economic shocks. For Ethiopia, the projected change in Africa's economic rankings highlights the challenge of sustaining rapid domestic growth while managing currency pressures, inflation and foreign-exchange constraints. For Ghana, moving ahead in nominal GDP terms would mark a recovery in its relative economic position, but translating that ranking into lasting gains in investment, employment and industrial development remains a separate challenge. While Ghana's nominal GDP is set to increase, Ethiopia is expected to experience a higher real growth rate of 9.2%, compared to Ghana's 5.7%. The depreciation of the Ethiopian birr has impacted its dollar-denominated GDP, despite strong domestic growth. However, the change in nominal GDP rankings does not necessarily reflect improved living standards or economic capacity, highlighting the influence of exchange rates and macroeconomic conditions on economic measurements.

ethiopia.title: Alliance for Survival Rejects Rubio's Characterization of Ethiopia's Conflict As Separatist, Terrorist
ethiopia.content: Ethiopia: Alliance for Survival Rejects Rubio's Characterization of Ethiopia's Conflict As Separatist, Terrorist - allAfrica.com AllAfrica English (current) En Français Toggle navigation My Account Toggle navigation AllAfrica My Account English (current) En Français Ethiopia: Alliance for Survival Rejects Rubio's Characterization of Ethiopia's Conflict As Separatist, Terrorist © RFI/Noé Hochet-Bodin The primary school in Erebti, Ethiopia, was bombed and destroyed during clashes between Tigrayan TPLF rebels and regional militiamen on May 4, 2022. 19 October 2026 Addis Standard (Addis Ababa) Addis Abeba — The Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Alliance for Survival (Alliance for Survival), a coalition of armed and political groups opposing the federal government, has rejected remarks by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio characterizing aspects of Ethiopia's conflict as separatist and terrorist, calling on Washington to adopt what it described as a balanced approach to the conflict. In a statement issued on 18 October, the alliance said its military operations were not driven by separatist objectives or intended to fragment the country. Instead, it described its actions as self-defense after what it called the government's rejection of efforts to achieve a peaceful resolution, including through the November 2022 Pretoria Agreement. The alliance said its stated objective was to facilitate an inclusive democratic transition, restore peace and stability, and allow Ethiopians to determine the country's political future. It also rejected the characterization of its attacks on government military installations as terrorism, arguing that such descriptions misrepresented the conflict. The alliance accused government forces of using more advanced weapons against both military targets and densely populated civilian areas in territories under its control. Addis Standard could not independently verify the allegations. Follow us on WhatsApp | LinkedIn for the latest headlines The statement warned that such characterizations could encourage the government to continue its military campaign and undermine efforts to resolve the conflict peacefully. The alliance urged the United States to adopt what it called a balanced and constructive position to support a lasting peace in Ethiopia. The statement follows Rubio's remarks on the conflict in Ethiopia during an interview with C-SPAN. The Alliance for Survival brings together several armed and political groups opposed to the federal government, including the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), the Amhara Fano National Movement (AFNM), and other groups from different regions. Its formation was announced in September amid renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia. Rubio's remarks come amid continued clashes between federal government forces and armed groups affiliated with the Alliance for Survival across multiple fronts in northern Ethiopia and other parts of the country. On 24 September 2026, Addis Standard reported that the European Union had expressed concern over the formation of a new coalition of Ethiopian opposition and armed groups, warning of a deteriorating security situation in northern Ethiopia and its impact on civilians. The EU said it was "deeply concerned by the rapidly deteriorating situation in Northern Ethiopia and its impact on the population," citing reports of military activity across multiple localities. It called for "immediate de-escalation" and urged the parties to recommit to the November 2022 Permanent Cessation of Hostilities Agreement, signed in Pretoria between the federal government and the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF). The EU stressed that differences between the parties could "only be resolved through dialogue and not military action" and called for compliance with international humanitarian law, emphasizing the obligation to protect civilians and safeguard the impartiality and independence of humanitarian operations. The coalition, initially announced as the Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Coalition for Survival, was formally unveiled on 20 September in a statement read live on Tigrai TV by Zemene Kassie , chairman of the Amhara Fano National Movement (AFNM). Seven opposition and armed groups declared a shared objective of removing the Prosperity Party-led government and establishing an inclusive transitional administration. The coalition comprises the AFNM, the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), the TPLF, the Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF), the Afar National Unity Revolutionary Front, the Benishangul Peoples' Liberation Movement, and the Gumuz Peoples' Democratic Movement. The announcement followed months of reported efforts to coordinate opposition groups across regional and political lines. In August, Zemene said agreements had been reached with several armed opposition groups to establish a broader alliance aimed at the "fall of Abiy Ahmed." The September announcement gave the emerging alignment a formal name and publicly stated its political objectives. Read the original article on Addis Standard . In a statement on October 18, the alliance, which includes various armed and political groups opposing the federal government, asserted that its military actions are acts of self-defense rather than attempts to fragment the country. They emphasized their goal of facilitating an inclusive democratic transition and restoring peace, while criticizing the government's military tactics against civilians. The alliance urged the U.S. to adopt a balanced approach to the conflict, warning that mischaracterizations could hinder peaceful resolutions. ethiopia.title: Ugandans in Ethiopia Called to Contribute to Country's Growth Through Investment, Trade and Skills Transfer
ethiopia.content: Ethiopia: Ugandans in Ethiopia Called to Contribute to Country's Growth Through Investment, Trade and Skills Transfer - allAfrica.com AllAfrica English (current) En Français Toggle navigation My Account Toggle navigation AllAfrica My Account English (current) En Français Ethiopia: Ugandans in Ethiopia Called to Contribute to Country's Growth Through Investment, Trade and Skills Transfer 19 October 2026 The Independent (Kampala) Addis Ababa — Uganda convened its diaspora community in Ethiopia for a two-day event at the Hilton Addis Ababa, centered on "Connecting, Celebrating and Contributing: Harnessing the Ugandan Diaspora for National Development." The forum aimed to strengthen ties between Ugandans living in Ethiopia and national development priorities, while showcasing Uganda's culture, investment opportunities, and talent to a global audience. The Ugandan community in Ethiopia is composed of a diverse and influential network, including professionals, students, business people, families, researchers, and staff from regional and international organizations. Ethiopia's status as a hub for the African Union and numerous NGOs provides a unique setting for diaspora engagement, enabling participants to tap into valuable professional networks, to exchange knowledge, and explore cross-border business opportunities. Speaking at a dinner hosted by the Uganda Embassy, Amb. Rebecca Amuge Otengo, Ambassador of Uganda to Ethiopia welcomed the guests and delivered the best wishes of President Yoweri Kaguta Museveni. She emphasized that their presence in Ethiopia is important. Pointing out that through their professional work, businesses, studies and daily interactions, they contribute to Uganda's image and to the longstanding friendship between Uganda and Ethiopia. She encouraged them to continue conducting themselves with integrity, respecting the laws and customs of the host country, and contributing positively to the communities in which they live and work. Keep up with the latest headlines on WhatsApp | LinkedIn "As we pursue opportunities abroad, let us never forget home. Our families, communities and country remain an important part of who we are. I encourage you to maintain close contact with your families, remain informed about developments in Uganda and, whenever circumstances permit, visit home and explore opportunities to contribute to our national development." said, Otengo "The development of our country is a shared responsibility. Each of us has something to contribute, whether through professional expertise, new ideas, investment, enterprise or support to our families and communities. Let us turn our presence in Ethiopia into an opportunity to deepen Uganda-Ethiopia relations, promote shared prosperity and contribute to Uganda's transformation." Wondafrash Debere Tolera who represented Amb Zerihun Abebe, Director-General for African Affairs at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Federal Republic of Ethiopia at the dinner addressed the Ugandan Community and hailed them for the being exemplary in behavior and for their developmental approach while living in Ethiopia. Mr Tolera emphasized the importance of people-to-people ties, hailing the growing Ethiopian Community in the Kampala suburbs of Muyenga, Kansanga and Buziga which has now acquired the moniker 'Little Ethiopia". He said they would like to see the warm reception given to the Ethiopian people, grow into a thriving commercial and business relationship. ethiopia.title: Ethiopia, U.S. Treasury Reaffirm Partnership to Deepen Economic Reforms and Bilateral Engagement
ethiopia.content: Ethiopia, U.S. Treasury Reaffirm Partnership to Deepen Economic Reforms and Bilateral Engagement - allAfrica.com AllAfrica English (current) En Français Toggle navigation My Account Toggle navigation AllAfrica My Account English (current) En Français Ethiopia, U.S. Treasury Reaffirm Partnership to Deepen Economic Reforms and Bilateral Engagement 19 October 2026 Ethiopian News Agency (Addis Ababa) Addis Ababa — The Ethiopian high-level delegation met with Eric Meyer, Deputy Assistant Secretary for Africa and the Middle East at the U.S. Department of the Treasury, on the sidelines of the 2026 IMF-World Bank Group Annual Meetings in Bangkok. According to the social media post by National Bank of Ethiopia, the high-level engagement focused on exploring expanded avenues of technical and financial support, including within international financial institutions, to help sustain and accelerate Ethiopia's ongoing economic reforms. The two sides also exchanged views on political and security developments in the region. During the session, Deputy Assistant Secretary Meyer commended Ethiopia's commitment to structural economic reforms and underscored the United States' continued dedication to a constructive bilateral partnership. Both delegations concluded the meeting by agreeing to maintain regular, constructive dialogue to advance mutual development goals and foster regional stability. Read the original article on ENA . somalia.title: Live: Somalia’s U-17 Final Showdown with Uganda Underway - FTL Somalia
somalia.summary: The U-17 final match between Somalia and Uganda is currently taking place, showcasing the young talents of both nations. This highly anticipated showdown marks a significant moment for Somalia, as they aim to secure a victory on home soil. Fans are eagerly supporting their teams, creating an electric atmosphere at the venue. The match is expected to highlight the skills and potential of the players, with both sides looking to claim the championship title. As the game progresses, updates will continue to be provided on the developments and key moments of this crucial encounter.

somalia.title: Somalia beat Rwanda on penalties to reach CECAFA U-17 final - Hiiraan Online
somalia.summary: Somalia triumphed over Rwanda in a tense penalty shootout to secure a place in the CECAFA U-17 final. The match ended in a draw after regulation and extra time, leading to penalties where Somalia emerged victorious. This win marks a significant achievement for the Somali U-17 team, showcasing their resilience and skill in a competitive tournament. The final will see Somalia compete for the championship title, further highlighting the progress of youth football in the region.

somalia.title: Wadajir Party Chief: Somalia’s Leaders Are Consuming Resources Needed to Confront Al-Shabaab - FTL Somalia
somalia.summary: Wadajir Party Chief Abdirahman Abdishakur has criticized Somalia's leaders for mismanaging resources that are essential for combating the militant group Al-Shabaab. He emphasized that the ongoing corruption and diversion of funds are undermining efforts to enhance security and stability in the country. Abdishakur called for accountability and urged the government to prioritize the fight against Al-Shabaab by ensuring that resources are allocated effectively. He highlighted the urgent need for a united front among Somali leaders to address the security challenges posed by the group, which continues to threaten the safety of citizens and hinder national progress.

somalia.title: OIC reaffirms support for Somalia’s territorial integrity during talks in Baghdad - Hiiraan Online
somalia.summary: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) has reiterated its commitment to Somalia's territorial integrity during discussions held in Baghdad. The meeting focused on various issues affecting the region, with member states expressing solidarity with Somalia amid ongoing challenges. The OIC emphasized the importance of unity and cooperation among member nations to support Somalia's stability and development. Participants highlighted the need for a collective approach to address security concerns and promote peace in the country. The reaffirmation of support comes as Somalia continues to navigate complex political and security landscapes, with the OIC pledging to assist in efforts aimed at strengthening the nation's sovereignty and territorial claims.

somalia.title: Somalia angry as Ethiopia refuses to intervene in South West State conflict - Somali Guardian
somalia.summary: Somalia has expressed frustration over Ethiopia's decision not to intervene in the ongoing conflict in the South West State. The tensions in the region have escalated, leading to violence and instability, prompting calls for external assistance. Somali officials have criticized Ethiopia's stance, emphasizing the need for support to restore peace and security. The conflict has raised concerns about the humanitarian situation and the potential for further escalation if left unaddressed. Somalia's government is urging regional partners to take a more active role in resolving the crisis and ensuring stability in the area. The lack of intervention from Ethiopia, a key player in the region, has heightened anxieties about the future of South West State and its impact on broader national security.

somalia.title: Somalia Reviews National Social Protection System - Mirage News
somalia.summary: Somalia is currently reviewing its National Social Protection System to enhance its effectiveness and reach. The initiative aims to provide better support for vulnerable populations, including those affected by conflict and climate change. The government, in collaboration with international partners, is assessing existing programs and identifying gaps to improve service delivery. This review is part of a broader effort to establish a comprehensive social safety net that can address the needs of the most disadvantaged communities. Stakeholders are encouraged to participate in the process to ensure that the revised system is inclusive and responsive to the challenges faced by the population. The outcome of this review is expected to strengthen social protection mechanisms in Somalia.

somalia.title: Somalia: AI-altered photo falsely claims Al-Shabaab leader appeared among fighters seen in Diinsoor during capture by pro-Laftagareen's forces - Horn Observer
somalia.summary: A manipulated photo circulating online falsely claims that Al-Shabaab leader Ahmed Diriye was present among fighters in Diinsoor during their capture by pro-Laftagareen forces. The image, altered using artificial intelligence, misrepresents the situation and has been shared widely on social media. Authorities and fact-checkers have identified the photo as misleading, emphasizing the importance of verifying information before sharing. This incident highlights the growing concern over the use of AI technology in creating deceptive content, particularly in conflict zones like Somalia, where misinformation can have serious implications for security and public perception.

somalia.title: Somalis Displaced by 2023 Floods Face New Threat as El Niño Looms, WFP Says - FTL Somalia
somalia.summary: The World Food Programme (WFP) has warned that Somalis displaced by the devastating floods of 2023 are facing an additional threat as the El Niño weather phenomenon approaches. The floods have already displaced over 1.5 million people, exacerbating food insecurity in the region. With El Niño expected to bring further unpredictable weather patterns, including heavy rains and droughts, the situation could worsen for those already vulnerable. The WFP emphasizes the urgent need for humanitarian assistance to support displaced families and prevent a deeper crisis. The agency is calling for increased funding and resources to address the immediate needs of affected populations and to prepare for the potential impacts of El Niño.

somalia.title: Somali Man Speaks Out on Mogadishu Streets About El Niño Threats. - African Arguments
somalia.summary: A Somali man has voiced concerns about the potential impacts of El Niño on the streets of Mogadishu. He highlighted the risks associated with the climate phenomenon, which could exacerbate existing challenges in the region, including food insecurity and displacement. The man emphasized the need for urgent action and preparedness to mitigate the effects of El Niño, particularly as Somalia faces ongoing humanitarian crises. He called for increased awareness and support from both local communities and international organizations to address the looming threats posed by climate change. The discussion reflects broader worries among residents about the implications of changing weather patterns on their livelihoods and well-being.

somalia.title: Extreme flooding expected in Somalia will impact food security – expert - power 98.7
somalia.summary: Extreme flooding is anticipated in Somalia, raising concerns about its impact on food security, according to experts. The heavy rains, exacerbated by climate change, are expected to lead to significant flooding in various regions, displacing communities and damaging crops. This situation poses a severe threat to an already vulnerable population that has been grappling with food shortages due to previous droughts and ongoing conflict. Experts warn that the flooding could further disrupt agricultural activities, leading to increased food prices and heightened malnutrition rates. Humanitarian organizations are urged to prepare for the impending crisis to mitigate its effects on the affected populations.

football.title: الهلال السوداني يصنع الحدث و"غربال" على موعد مع المجد - شبكة تواصل الإخبارية
football.summary: الهلال السوداني حقق إنجازًا كبيرًا في مسيرته الكروية، حيث تمكن من الوصول إلى مراحل متقدمة في المنافسات القارية. اللاعب "غربال" كان له دور بارز في هذا النجاح، حيث أظهر مهاراته العالية وأداءه المتميز في المباريات. الجماهير تتطلع إلى المزيد من الإنجازات، مع آمال كبيرة في تحقيق الألقاب. الهلال يسعى لتعزيز مكانته في الساحة الرياضية، ويبدو أن الفريق في طريقه لتحقيق المجد الذي يطمح إليه.

football.title: الهلال السوداني والسويحلي الليبي يقتربان من مجموعات دوري الأبطال - مانكيش نت
football.summary: اقترب فريق الهلال السوداني وفريق السويحلي الليبي من التأهل إلى مرحلة المجموعات في دوري أبطال أفريقيا. جاء ذلك بعد الأداء القوي الذي قدمه الفريقان في المباريات التمهيدية. الهلال السوداني حقق نتائج إيجابية في مبارياته السابقة، مما يعزز فرصه في التأهل، بينما تمكن السويحلي من تقديم عرض قوي في التصفيات. يتطلع كلا الفريقين إلى تحقيق النجاح في المرحلة المقبلة من البطولة، حيث تعتبر هذه المنافسة فرصة كبيرة لإظهار مهاراتهم على المستوى القاري.

football.title: الهلال السوداني والسويحلي الليبي يقتربان من دور المجموعات في دوري ابطال افريقيا - شبكة تواصل الإخبارية
football.summary: اقترب فريق الهلال السوداني وفريق السويحلي الليبي من التأهل إلى دور المجموعات في دوري أبطال إفريقيا بعد أدائهما المتميز في التصفيات. حيث حقق الهلال السوداني فوزًا كبيرًا على منافسه في المباراة الأخيرة، مما يعزز فرصه في التأهل. من جهة أخرى، قدم السويحلي الليبي عرضًا قويًا في مباراته، مما جعله قريبًا من تحقيق نفس الهدف. يتطلع كلا الفريقين إلى مواصلة النجاح في البطولة الإفريقية، حيث تعتبر هذه المرحلة مهمة جدًا في مسيرتهما.

football.title: الهلال السوداني يحسم مواجهة سيداما بونا ويقترب من التأهل الأفريقي - اخبار السودان
football.summary: حقق فريق الهلال السوداني فوزًا مهمًا على سيداما بونا الإثيوبي في مباراة ضمن تصفيات دوري أبطال أفريقيا، مما يقربه من التأهل للمرحلة التالية. انتهت المباراة بفوز الهلال بنتيجة 2-0، حيث سجل الأهداف كل من اللاعب محمد عبد الرحمن واللاعب وليد الشعلة. قدم الفريق أداءً قويًا خلال المباراة، مما ساهم في تعزيز فرصه في المنافسة على اللقب الأفريقي. بهذا الفوز، يواصل الهلال مسيرته الناجحة في البطولة ويعزز من موقفه في المجموعة.

football.title: موعد بث مواجهة الهلال وسيداما والقنوات الناقلة للقاء المرتقب اليوم - موقع رادار
football.summary: تقام اليوم مواجهة مرتقبة بين فريق الهلال وسيداما، حيث ينتظر عشاق كرة القدم هذه المباراة بفارغ الصبر. ستبدأ المباراة في تمام الساعة 8:00 مساءً بتوقيت مكة المكرمة. سيتم بث اللقاء عبر عدة قنوات، منها القناة الرياضية السعودية، بالإضافة إلى منصات البث المباشر على الإنترنت. يُعتبر هذا اللقاء مهمًا للفريقين، حيث يسعى الهلال لتحقيق الفوز لتعزيز موقفه في البطولة، بينما يأمل سيداما في تقديم أداء قوي أمام خصمهم.

football.title: موعد بث مواجهة الهلال وسيداما والقنوات الناقلة للقاء المرتقب اليوم - موقع رادار
football.summary: تستعد جماهير كرة القدم لمتابعة مواجهة الهلال وسيداما اليوم، حيث من المقرر أن تنطلق المباراة في تمام الساعة 8:00 مساءً بتوقيت مكة المكرمة. ستقام المباراة في إطار المنافسات القارية، مما يزيد من حماس المشجعين. يمكن متابعة اللقاء عبر عدة قنوات ناقلة، منها قناة "SSC" التي تمتلك حقوق البث، بالإضافة إلى منصات البث المباشر. يُتوقع أن تكون المباراة مثيرة، حيث يسعى الهلال لتحقيق الفوز وتعزيز موقفه في البطولة.

football.title: السويحلي يسقط الترجي وتعادل صنداونز.. نتائج ذهاب دور الـ32 من دوري أبطال أفريقيا - يلاكورة
football.summary: حقق فريق السويحلي فوزًا مهمًا على الترجي التونسي في ذهاب دور الـ32 من دوري أبطال أفريقيا، مما يعزز آماله في التأهل للدور المقبل. في مباراة أخرى، انتهت مواجهة صنداونز الجنوب أفريقي مع منافسه بالتعادل، مما يجعل الأمور مفتوحة في مباراة الإياب. تأتي هذه النتائج في إطار المنافسات القوية التي يشهدها دوري أبطال أفريقيا، حيث يسعى كل فريق لتحقيق أفضل أداء لضمان التأهل.

football.title: مدرب الهلال يتوعد سيداما ويثق في بلوغ مجموعات دوري الأبطال - winwin
football.summary: مدرب الهلال، رامون دياز، أعرب عن ثقته في قدرة فريقه على تجاوز عقبة سيداما الإثيوبي في التصفيات المؤهلة لدوري أبطال آسيا. خلال مؤتمر صحفي، أكد دياز أن الهلال يمتلك الإمكانيات اللازمة لتحقيق الفوز والتأهل إلى مرحلة المجموعات. وأشار إلى أهمية المباراة وضرورة التركيز على الأداء الجيد، مشددًا على أن الفريق جاهز تمامًا لمواجهة التحديات. كما أعرب عن تفاؤله بقدرة اللاعبين على تقديم مستوى مميز يضمن لهم النجاح في هذه المرحلة الحاسمة.

football.title: الهلال السوداني يقترب من مجموعات الأبطال بثنائية.. ومولودية الجزائر في ورطة - الجمهور الإخباري
football.summary: حقق فريق الهلال السوداني فوزاً مهماً على ضيفه مولودية الجزائر بنتيجة 2-0 في مباراة الذهاب من الدور التمهيدي لدوري أبطال أفريقيا. بهذا الانتصار، اقترب الهلال من التأهل إلى مرحلة المجموعات، حيث قدم أداءً قوياً واستطاع تسجيل هدفين في الشوط الثاني. في المقابل، يواجه مولودية الجزائر تحديات كبيرة بعد هذه الخسارة، مما يزيد من ضغوط الفريق قبل مباراة الإياب. يحتاج الفريق الجزائري إلى تحقيق نتيجة إيجابية في المباراة القادمة لضمان فرصه في التأهل.

football.title: الهلال السوداني يضرب في إثيوبيا ويقترب من مجموعات أبطال أفريقيا - السودان اليوم
football.summary: حقق فريق الهلال السوداني فوزاً مهماً على مضيفه فاسيل كيتيما الإثيوبي في مباراة الذهاب من الدور التمهيدي لدوري أبطال أفريقيا. انتهت المباراة بفوز الهلال بنتيجة 2-0، مما يعزز فرصه في التأهل إلى مرحلة المجموعات. سجل أهداف الهلال كل من اللاعب محمد عبد الرحمن واللاعب وليد الشعلة، حيث قدم الفريق أداءً مميزاً خلال اللقاء. ومن المقرر أن تقام مباراة الإياب في السودان، حيث يسعى الهلال إلى تأكيد تفوقه وضمان التأهل. يعتبر هذا الفوز خطوة إيجابية نحو تحقيق طموحات الفريق في البطولة الأفريقية.
